title: Every germ of a quasi-coherent module lifts from a global finitely presented module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $x\in X$ and $s\in\mathcal F_x$, where $\mathcal F_x$ denotes the ordinary Zariski module stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then there exist a sheaf $\mathcal G$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$, and a germ $t\in\mathcal G_x$ such that $\psi_x(t)=s$.

source.place: Stacks Properties, Tag 01PJ, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation, surjectivity paragraph, lines 3164-3188: the global finitely presented module G and a germ mapping to the prescribed s, before choosing its representative in the diagram.

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], choose an open neighbourhood $W$ of $x$ and $a_0\in\mathcal F(W)$ with $(a_0)_x=s$. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], choose an affine open $x\in U\subseteq W$. Put $a=a_0|_U$; restriction does not change its germ, so $a_x=s$. The open subscheme $U$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs].

source.place: Stacks Tag 01PJ, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation, proof, final surjectivity paragraph (lines 3173-3188).

proof.text: Define $\mu_a:\mathcal O_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ on each open $V\subseteq U$ by $r\mapsto r\,a|_V$. The module laws give $\mathcal O_U(V)$-linearity, and semilinearity of restriction gives $(r\,a|_V)|_{V'}=r|_{V'}\,a|_{V'}$ for $V'\subseteq V$, so these maps form a module-sheaf morphism. The sheaf $\mathcal O_U$ has finite presentation by [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]: take $m=0$, $n=1$, and the zero map $0\to\mathcal O_U$, whose cokernel is $\mathcal O_U$.

source.place: Stacks Tag 01PJ, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation, proof, final surjectivity paragraph (lines 3173-3188).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-finite-presentation-extension] to $X$, the quasi-compact open $U$, the given quasi-coherent $\mathcal F$, the finitely presented source $\mathcal O_U$, and $\mu_a$. Its hypotheses hold by the assumptions on $X$ and $\mathcal F$ and the preceding steps. Obtain a finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$, a map $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$, and an isomorphism $e:\mathcal G|_U\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_U$ with $\psi|_U=\mu_a\circ e$.

source.place: Stacks Tag 01PJ, lemma-directed-colimit-diagram-finite-presentation, proof, final surjectivity paragraph (lines 3173-3188).

proof.text: The component of $e^{-1}$ at $U$ sends $1\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ to a section $b\in\mathcal G(U)$ satisfying $e_U(b)=1$. Set $t=b_x\in\mathcal G_x$. By the formula for the stalk map in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and the equality of morphisms in the preceding step, $\psi_x(t)=(\psi_U(b))_x=(\mu_{a,U}(e_U(b)))_x=(1\cdot a)_x=a_x=s$. Thus $\mathcal G$, $\psi$, and $t$ have all the required properties.
